description: This file defines a SchemaOrg class for extracting and processing recipe data from schema.org structured data embedded in web pages. It includes methods for parsing various recipe attributes such as title, ingredients, instructions, ratings, and more, utilizing external utilities and handling different schema.org types.

classes.name: SchemaOrg
classes.description: A class for extracting and parsing recipe data from schema.org structured data in web pages.

methods.name: _contains_schematype
methods.description: Checks if a schema.org item contains a specific type.

methods.name: _find_entity
methods.description: Finds a schema.org entity of a specific type within a given item.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the SchemaOrg object by extracting and processing schema.org data from page data.

methods.name: site_name
methods.description: Returns the website name from schema.org data.

methods.name: language
methods.description: Returns the language of the recipe.

methods.name: author
methods.description: Returns the author of the recipe.

methods.name: _read_duration_field
methods.description: Reads and converts duration fields like totalTime, prepTime, cookTime.

methods.name: ingredients
methods.description: Returns a list of recipe ingredients.

methods.name: _extract_howto_instructions_text
methods.description: Extracts instruction text from schema.org HowTo schema.

methods.name: instructions
methods.description: Returns the recipe instructions as a string.
